verdict: Spend is live but zero leads received — infrastructure must be fixed first.
narrative: In the last 28 days, your Meta campaigns generated 210 clicks and spent $104.96, yet you received zero leads — conversion tracking or the landing page is not functioning correctly, so clicks are not being captured as inquiries. This is a tracking and infrastructure problem, not an ad performance problem. Nine project milestones — including landing pages, conversion tracking, and CRM setup — are overdue, and these are being prioritized and resolved now before additional spend is committed. Separately, a sharp drop in website sessions on September 10 is being investigated as a possible tracking or site issue. Once the infrastructure is confirmed working, paid campaigns will be in a position to deliver the lead volume the spend level should support.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period from 210 paid clicks and $104.96 in Meta spend
clicks delivered by Meta ads this period — traffic is reaching your site, but not converting
organic actions on your Google Business Profile this period (calls, direction requests, and site clicks)

watch_item.issue: Zero leads despite active ad spend — conversion tracking and landing pages are not recording inquiries correctly.
watch_item.fix: Conversion tracking and landing page setup are being completed this week; spend will be paused or held until the full path from click to lead is confirmed working.
